title: MAT-over-ACP request sketch (MAT-100 spike — non-normative)
description: Shows how MAT-2 governance fields sit beside ACP session transport hints. Not for production validation.

correlation_id.description: MAT trace id; adapters SHOULD also place this in ACP _meta.

idempotency_key.description: MAT-only. ACP has no task idempotency; runtime caches MAT2Response by this key.

repo_root.description: Mapped to ACP session/new cwd (after ~ expansion).

timeout_ms.description: Client wall-clock; on expiry adapter sends session/cancel.

op.description: MAT allowlisted op — not an ACP method. Rejected if not in codex-code-exec manifest.

params.description: Same shapes as schemas/codex-code-exec/v1/request.schema.json $defs for the given op.

kind.description: Distinguishes from legacy kind=exec (codex exec stdout).

acp_session_id.description: If set, adapter calls session/resume; else session/new.

permission_mode.description: How the MAT client answers session/request_permission.

prompt_template.description: Optional override; default derives from op + params + agent system prompt.
